title: The WO Parts tab loads without Failed to load part request data and the PO description lock still holds
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. At Staging Heavy Duty: the work order with the open part request for QAPL-T3; the seeded estimate holding QAPL-I1; the open purchase order with QAPL-T2 lines. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order with the QAPL-T3 request and click its Parts tab.
  2. Click the QAPL-T3 request.
  3. Open the seeded estimate's Parts tab.
  4. Open the open purchase order and open a QAPL-T2 line for editing.
  5. On the same purchase order click Add item and pick QAPL-T1.
custom_expected:
1. Every part request on the work order is listed, QAPL-T3 included; no "Failed to load part request data." toast and no failed request in Network.
  2. The part request opens with its part selected and its bins shown, with no error.
  3. Every request is listed, the inactive QAPL-I1 included; no "Failed to load part request data." toast.
  4. The line's Description stays locked (not editable), as before the release.
  5. The new item takes QAPL-T1's description and it is locked as on the existing lines, as before the release.
